parse-request.purpose: Turn the request's free text into a config shown to you.

classify-annotation.purpose: Classify a skip-if as scoping or flakiness.

write-annotation-patches.purpose: Write the run-if commit and the DEBUG un-skip commit.

plan-try-pushes.purpose: Plan the try pushes, each with a command and a purpose.

triage-try.purpose: Classify failures fx-tests couldn't parse or that match no patch.

merge-clusters.purpose: Merge or split failure clusters grouped by exact message.

prior-art-verdict.purpose: Decide whether someone is already on a failure, or a bug can be reused.

investigate-and-fix.purpose: Investigate and fix one failure group, as today's subagents do.

review-patch.step: 2. First signal, 4. Investigate and fix, 9. Review comments
review-patch.purpose: Critical review of one commit, diff and message.

revise-bug-draft.purpose: Revise a bug draft from your comments.

resolve-conflict.purpose: Resolve a text conflict while assembling or rewriting the stack.

estimate-review-effort.purpose: Rate a patch's review effort from 1 to 5.

review-stack.purpose: Review the assembled stack as a whole.

address-review.purpose: Resume the author to address review comments, returning replies only where code doesn't speak for itself.

adapt-soft-dep.purpose: Adjust two patches whose soft dependency was flipped by a reorder (Sonnet if not trivial).

recover.purpose: Turn your free text into a plan of factory commands.
